quest.title: A Thousand Miles for an Enigmatic Tune
quest.description: You return to Liyue with Paimon in anticipation of yet another unforgettable time at the Lantern Rite Festival...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

chapter.num: The Exquisite Night Chimes: Part I
chapter.title: A Thousand Miles for an Enigmatic Tune

talks.objective: Take a walk around Liyue Harbor

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon votes we go say hi to Xiangling first...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? Zhongli! What a pleasant surprise meeting you here!

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Oh? Why, the pleasure is all mine... as is the surprise, surely.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: It must be fate that brings us together in this place. How have you fared as of late?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: I sense you are older and wiser than the last time we met. It seems your travels continue to yield valuable insights.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Thank you, Zhongli.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: You are too kind.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So Zhongli, are you here to listen to stories over tea again?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: I had originally planned to set out after this last round of tea. However...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: However...?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: I had planned to take a walk to Qingce Village and gather some nascent Bamboo Shoots, which are currently in season. A villager there once gave me a small sample, and they possessed a most excellent flavor.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? "Nascent" Bamboo Shoots...? Why can't you just use normal Bamboo Shoots instead?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, Paimon knows! Because Zhongli prefers the finer things in life, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, Mr. Particular, lemme guess... The "nascent" Bamboo Shoot has a uniquely tender texture and a delicate, sweet taste that its "normal" cousin cannot match.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: An astute observation, Paimon. You know me well indeed.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Lantern Rite is almost upon us, but besides the Bamboo Shoots, there are a few other items I have not yet procured from Director Hu's list... May I ask if you have already made arrangements for the days ahead?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, well, we were planning to use the opportunity to say hi to some of our friends! But before we were able to figure out a schedule, we ran into you.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Well then, might I invite you to imagine the sheer delight that is a soup cooked with the freshest nascent Bamboo Shoots in all the land? Generous cuts of pork belly and crisp, fragrant Bamboo Shoots, placed together in the pot, and left to simmer slowly for half a day...

choices.text: I've never had anything like it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh! You're doing this on purpose, aren't you!? Paimon's onto your plan — you just wanna hoodwink us into fetching your bamboo for you!

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Hmm? Why, I assure you, I would do no such thing. I merely wished to inform you of the freshest, most succulent and flavorful Bamboo Shoots one could ever hope to taste.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #You... Ugh, let's go, {NICKNAME}! Paimon's tastebuds can't take it anymore!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Ready to go when you are!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Collecting a few Bamboo Shoots shouldn't take too long. Paimon has got to get her hands on some of that soup!

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Such fine specimens are indeed well worth the excursion. Very well, I shall leave the Bamboo Shoots to you. Should you have the good fortune to find some, please share them with me as well.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: See, see! Paimon knew he was just bamboozling us!

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: However, there is no need to rush.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: The streets of Liyue will be bustling with visitors and filled with all manner of celebrations during the festive period. By all means, go wherever your interests lead you.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: The nascent Bamboo Shoots would be but a wonderful final touch to a most exceptional feast. What an honor it would be to savor them in the company of friends.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We're heading out! Enjoy your walk, Zhongli.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Take care now, you two.

choices.text: We will check in with you later at Wangsheng Funeral Parlor.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Setbacks are inevitable over the course of a long journey. If you wish to share what's troubling you, allow me to lend my ear. There is no need to shoulder all burdens by yourself.

talks.objective: Go to the one calling for help

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: A short and slender figure rescues the drowning man, and brings him back to shore...
...Are you okay? Did any water go down the wrong pipe?
*cough* *cough*...
Phew... I—I think I'm okay now. Thank you so much...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That was scary... Well, at least you're alright! All thanks to your savior here... oh, a little girl?

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Greetings, everyone. My name is Yaoyao. It's a pleasure to make your acquaintance.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, she's so well-mannered!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #My name's Paimon, and this is {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Greetings.

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: I'm Dvorak, a musician from Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: I came through Stone Gate, intending to head towards Liyue Harbor, but then I became captivated by the beautiful scenery... and before long, I was completely lost.

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Just now, I was so mesmerized by the waterfall that I slipped and fell into the water. If it weren't for Miss Yaoyao's help, I shudder to think what might have happened...

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: It's alright, Mr. Dvorak.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: The splashing around the bottom of the waterfall means the stone path is always wet and slippy. You definitely have to be careful.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Next time you're exploring an unfamiliar environment, try to focus on what's right in front of you. Don't let your mind wander.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: As long as you watch your step, accidents like this won't happen anymore!

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Yes Ma'am, I understand... I'll remember to be more careful next time.

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: *grumble*

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Oh... Are you hungry, Sir?

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Oh, uh... I'll be fine, heh...

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Please, Sir, it's quite alright! I was born and raised here in Liyue. It's only natural for me to extend my hospitality to any guests who are passing through.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: I expect you still have quite a long journey ahead of you? It's very important to keep your energy levels up.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: I still have some Lotus Flower Crisps left in my backpack. Why don't we split them between the four of us?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aww... what a thoughtful kid! She even has some for Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Hehe, you're welcome!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Everyone savors some Delicious Lotus Flower Crisps as they enjoy the scenery...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mmm, so tasty... If only there were more...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: More!? You already had the Sumpter Beast's share...

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Having a healthy appetite is a good thing! It means Paimon's still growing. If I'd known I was gonna run into you, I would have made a second batch.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hope you're taking notes, Traveler. This is how you treat your Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: What do you think, Sir? Are Liyue's snacks to your taste? I wonder if they're not sweet enough?

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: No no, they're perfect.

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: When I was traveling through Mondstadt, I had a chance to try one of their Moon Pies. It had a meat filling, unlike these crisps. But apart from that, it seems like they follow a similar cooking process. Both are delicious in their own way.

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: As for Fontaine's cooking, though... Ah, it's been a long time since I've had a taste of home.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds like you spend a lot of time on the road, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: I do. It's part of my job — I'm one of the main organizers of the Iridescence Tour.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Iridescence Tour?

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: The Iridescence Tour is one of the biggest music festivals in Fontaine. We're looking to expand, though. Our aim is to hold a festival in every nation.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: At least, all the main organizers share this goal. Unfortunately...

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: *sigh* It's a long story, so I'll spare you the details. But anyway, so the main reason I'm traveling all around Teyvat is to promote our music festivals. But I have some... personal reasons, too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, what are they? Just tell us already!

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Let me see... well, to explain it in full, I'd have to start with a story from my ancestors... I don't want to take up too much of your time?

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: I love listening to stories!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mm-hmm, we want to hear it too!

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Okay. Then I'll start from the beginning.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: The story goes that my ancestor, who was also a traveler, once slipped and fell into a lake during his travels. As he was sinking and gasping for breath, he heard a wondrous tune in the air...

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: They say it was the most beautiful, moving melody he had ever heard.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Even in that life-and-death moment, the ethereal music seized his full attention, and almost made him forget the fact that he was drowning...

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: When he finally came to, he found that he had already been brought ashore. Not too far from him stood an unfamiliar woman with an almost divine aura.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Once she saw that he was no longer in danger, she left without a word.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: My ancestor tried to run after her to give his thanks. But although a mere dozen paces separated them, no matter how quickly he gave chase, he drew no closer, and remained a dozen paces behind.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: In the end, all he could do was to bow in thanks to the woman as he watched her walk away towards the rivers and mountains in the distance, before at last he turned around and made his way home.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Once he returned to Fontaine, he began to learn an instrument, so that he could spread his story far and wide, just like the bards.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: After generations of retelling, embellishing, and dramatizing, people have come to think of that lady as something like a fairy.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: The story's become something of a local legend in Fontaine. It's called, "The Lady Overlooking the Lake."

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: People now say that if you go down to the lakeside and play an instrument, so long as you play a pleasing melody, you will hear a fairy lady, who is hiding out of sight, playing along with you...

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Wowwwww!

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Well, yes, as it stands now, it's become a touch too romantic and detached from reality... But I understand the original story and its historical grounding better than anyone else.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: I wanted to find out the truth of this tale. So I decided to retrace my ancestor's steps, and search for that lady's modern-day descendants.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Of course, there's no way of knowing where my ancestor fell into the lake all those years ago. So I always knew that the search would be akin to looking for a needle in a haystack.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: I've spent many years on the road now, and I'm nowhere near as fit as I was in my youth. The wish that I have spent half my life chasing after has now become something of an obsession...

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: I haven't lived half of my life yet, but still... I understand how you must feel.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon too...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's like... imagine if you'd saved the center of a Lotus Flower Crisp — which is the best part, by the way — 'cause you wanted to eat it another day, but then suddenly, sploosh! It falls into the water, never to be seen again!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon would definitely remember that for the rest of her life!

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Hahaha... There's no need to feel sorry for me. I have made some progress over the years. For example... I've concluded that the story must have taken place in Liyue.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh! So you finally found a lead?

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Yes. In fact, that's an intriguing story in and of itself.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: I'd always known that Mondstadt is the City of Song and Freedom. But more recently, I heard that the Anemo Archon returned to Mondstadt for a festival in the Fall, and learned that he himself is a patron deity of music.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: So, I prayed for the Anemo Archon's guidance in the Mondstadt Cathedral... and as soon as I set foot back outside the front gate, I noticed a cluster of leaves being blown in the wind, further and further west, towards Stone Gate.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: A friendly local told me that this meant the wind was guiding me in the direction of Liyue. So, I followed their advice, and made my way here.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That settles it then. It was Liyue.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Right? You get it! I knew I'd find someone that agrees with me eventually.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Hmm... are you sure? It sounds a bit too much like one of those fake legends told by those treasure hoarder guys to scam gullible grannies from Qingce Village...

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: "Rex Lapis has returned to the world! Just give me some incense and a little Mora towards the travel fees, and I will pass your gift on to the Lord of Geo, and ask him to keep you and your family safe and well..." And so on, and so on.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't worry, Yaoyao! We, uh... we have a lot of experience with deciphering omens and stuff.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And anyway, you only got scammed if you handed over Mora, right?

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Actually, to express my gratitude, I did spend rather a lot of Mora on several bottles of fine wine, which I left at the Statues of the Seven along the way...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh dear...

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Well, how about this, ladies and gentlemen — why don't I bring you all to Yujing Terrace to see Miss Ganyu?

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: I don't know very many people, so I can't help you out much, but Miss Ganyu and the Qixing know just about everything.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: If you've been scammed, they'll help you get your Mora back. And if the wind was telling the truth, and you wanna keep looking for that lady's family, they'll be the best people to ask.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That does sound like a good idea.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: But you've already helped me so much...

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: I was gonna take some new medicinal herbs and plants I picked to Miss Ganyu anyway, so it's no trouble at all!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You know what, it's been a minute since we saw Ganyu, too. It'd sure be nice to pay her a visit before Lantern Rite.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Alright. Well, my sincere thanks to you all. I will never forget your kindness.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Okay, everyone, please follow me! I'll be your guide. Remember to watch where you're going, okay?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh-oh, Paimon's out of a job... Eh, oh well! Paimon'll just be a cheerleader instead!

choices.text: At its heart is a true story.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Exactly. It may just be a legend to others, but for me, it's a real part of my family history.

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Wow, Liyue Harbor looks very different from when I came last...

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: It's almost as if... I'm listening to the same melody, but with a richer timbre, and new variations added...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, we are here during Lantern Rite, after all! It only comes once a year, so they always have a big celebration.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's fair to say that this time of year is when Liyue Harbor looks the prettiest!

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Great. Let's go and check it out.

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: I can't wait to get into the city and see it all up close for myself.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The doors and windows are all fine, so there definitely wasn't a break-in...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This place is completely empty... There's nothing valuable left here at all...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Hey, everyone! Fancy meeting you all here! What a nice surprise.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Hello, Xinyan! Let me introduce some new friends. They are...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, and Mr. Dvorak, right? Hehe, I've known them all for quite a while.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So you already know each other...

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Haha... When I was last here to advertise a Liyue stop for the Iridescence Tour, Xinyan was one of the few people willing to give me the time of day.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Feels like I've been chasing this Iridescence Tour bandwagon halfway around the world, but I keep getting stood up. What's going on, Mr. Dvorak?

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: *sigh* I am so sorry, Xinyan. We've had a string of terrible luck recently, and every time we've tried to put on a show, something or other has come up to stop our plans from materializing...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Is that right... Hmm, I guess it can't be helped.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: So what brings you to Liyue Harbor at this time of the year, anyway? Thinking of putting on a music festival during the Lantern Rite celebrations?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A Lantern Rite music festival? Yes please!

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: No, uh... I'm actually here on personal business this time.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Aw, so no Lantern Rite music festival?

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: I mean... That's not just up to me.

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Hosting a music festival takes a lot of funding and personnel. Moreover, I've never worked with the Liyue authorities before. Even if I were to start putting something together right now... I think it'd be too rushed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, but we're going to meet the Liyue Qixing, aren't we? And they're the ones in charge.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Uh-huh, that's right! Miss Keqing and Miss Ningguang can make anything happen.

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: You mean... What?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Hahaha, this is the perfect opportunity! Sure, it might not work out, but it can't hurt to bring it up as a suggestion.

choices.text: A Lantern Rite music festival would be something different.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: #That's the spirit! See, even {NICKNAME} agrees with me. Mr. Dvorak, don't let yourself be put off by the fact that a few things haven't worked out recently.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: As for the performers... I can put you in touch with some local artists.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: My friend Yun Jin is a well-known opera singer in Liyue. With her support and a commissioned song from the Yun-Han Opera Troupe, we should be able to get something going.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But what about you, Xinyan? Are you just going to sit this one out?

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Haha, what do you take me for?

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: If we actually manage to make the Iridescence Tour: Lantern Rite Grand Concert a reality, you think I'd let anyone else perform the opening act!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, there's that rock 'n' roll spirit, hehe.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: What do ya say, Mr. Dvorak?

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Hmm...

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Hmm... Okay. I'll give it a shot.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: But the opening act is not something to be chosen lightly, Xinyan. I will judge your work by the strictest of standards, so please make sure you are fully prepared.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Are you kidding? I thought you'd never ask!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Whew, guess my shopping time's getting cut short! I'm gonna head back right away and start working on this!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Yaoyao, if you run into your senior on your way to the Qixing, please send her my regards!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Okay, I promise I will! Good luck with your music, Xinyan.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You've got this, Xinyan!

choices.text: A Lantern Rite music festival would be a huge hit.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Oh! It's Master. Is it okay if I go and say hi to her?

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Oh, calm down now, dear, I'm not about to run off anywhere. I'm not a bundle of energy like you...

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: I haven't seen you in days, Master! I've missed you.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Aww, bless you, Yaoyao... you do say the sweetest things.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Ah, look who it is. Visiting friends during the Lantern Rite, are we?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Greetings, Madame Ping.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're half right, Madame Ping! We were also trying to help out Mr. Dvorak over here. We were on our way to take him to see the Qixing.

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Hello, Ma'am. I am a musician from Fontaine, and an organizer of the Iridescence Tour... I don't suppose you've heard of it...

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Master, Master, the Iridescence Tour is a super famous music festival!

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Hehe... An old lady like me wouldn't know much about that sort of thing. A music festival, you say? It sounds terribly exciting.

choices.text: If we could add some musical elements to Lantern Rite...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh right! Madame Ping, how would you feel about that?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're an elder of Liyue, and you know all about Liyue's cultural traditions. Hearing your thoughts would definitely help us figure out how best to approach it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: For example... do you think it might be a bit too modern, or is there any other issue?

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: Why, not at all. Music pays homage to history and culture, and it can also be a bridge between different civilizations.

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: Times change, and the music enjoyed by the youngsters of today is, no doubt, very different from the tunes I was accustomed to in my youth. Nevertheless, all fine things in life can be appreciated.

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: And so... I look forward to it immensely.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Hear, hear! I do believe that, my own dear grandmother aside, you are the wisest old lady I've ever met.

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: Goodness gracious, you're all being suspiciously sweet today. Yaoyao, whatever have you been feeding them?

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Master, you're in such a great mood today! You're even cracking jokes with the rest of us.

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: Hehe. Well, I'm sure you must have plenty to be getting on with, yes? Run along now, don't let me hold you up.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Thanks, Madame Ping! We'll see you again soon!

choices.text: If we could organize a Lantern Rite music festival...

talks.objective: Head near Yujing Terrace to look for Ganyu

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: ...and when you meet with the Ministry of Civil Affairs, please remind them that the festivities are not an excuse to procrastinate their work.

dialogues.speaker: Baixiao
dialogues.text: Understood, Miss Ganyu. I'll take my leave now.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Ganyuuu!

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: What brings you here, Yaoyao?

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: I've brought all the medicine you asked me to pick for you. Ah, and here's a pack of Sweet Flower seeds as well.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Also, also, these dried Qingxin leaves make a great pot of tea that's very good for you.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: I know you've had a lot to deal with at work recently, but you shouldn't push yourself too hard. If you're not careful, you'll end up falling asleep in the grass again...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well this is weird. It's like a responsible younger sister talking to their disorganized older sister...

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Ahem...

choices.text: Paimon, you're running your mouth again...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: #Thank you, {NICKNAME}, but Paimon's criticism is quite valid. I do have a tendency to neglect matters outside of work, and that's something I should improve on.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Oh, my apologies, I don't believe we've been introduced?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah! Paimon will do the honors!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Paimon tells Ganyu all about Mr. Dvorak, from how you met, to his family history, to your shared music festival aspirations.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Hmm...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wh—What's wrong? Did Paimon go over everything a bit too fast?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's definitely an ambitious plan... If there's anything you didn't quite catch, Paimon's more than happy to go over it again!

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: It may be... a little difficult to make this happen.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh?

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Well, the Lantern Rite is the most important festival of the year. Our celebrations must not only be visually spectacular, but also appeal to the tastes of Liyue citizens from all walks of life.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: The Iridescence Tour is relatively unknown in Liyue. It's difficult to predict how a brand-new show will be received.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: It would be quite risky for us to bet everything on this one music festival.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: *sigh* All very valid points. I completely understand...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Therefore, we will not replace or cancel any of our preexisting program. However... I will submit a proposal requesting to put the Iridescence Tour special performance as the final act of this year's festivities.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Some live music will certainly add to the festive atmosphere on the night of the Lantern Rite. As for the venue... Hmm, let's reserve a space at the docks.

choices.text: So we're not stealing anyone's thunder...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Yes. My thoughts precisely.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Now I just need to take some time to give this proposal some polish...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: #As long as I clearly lay out the pros and cons, and highlight the key points of the proposal... Given that Ping and {NICKNAME} have both given the idea their blessing, I'm confident the Qixing will be sure to give it serious consideration.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Mr. Dvorak, I will need to discuss with you the number of musicians who will be coming to Liyue, as well as their catering and accommodation requirements...

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Oh, yes, certainly... Let's step to the side and discuss further.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: As soon as there's work to do, Ganyu's as diligent as ever...

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: I couldn't agree more!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Master once said that everyone has things that they are good at, and things that they are less good at. So, with that in mind, Ganyu shouldn't feel compelled to become perfect at absolutely everything.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: I'm good at taking care of people, so that can be left to me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow... Hey, Yaoyao, can you take care of Paimon too? Paimon's getting hungry again!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Paimon, you're trying to freeload again.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: I'm afraid my backpack's empty now, but if you let me know what you like, I can bring you some of your favorite dishes next time we meet.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Apart from Lotus Flower Crisps, what else do you like?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anything sweet! And anything that's made from slimes...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: ...Here's what I've drafted so far. Anything else you want to add?

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: No, this is excellent! I'm racking my brains, but I don't think you've missed a single thing.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Perfect, then we'll leave it as-is. I'll go make an official copy.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Oh, perfect timing. We were just wrapping up our discussion here.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That was quick...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Not at all. Every second counts for a complex proposal such as this. I will inform the Qixing of this development immediately... please give me a moment to pass on the message.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Yaoyao, thank you for bringing my herbs. I will make sure to take them.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Remember to make tea from them first, Ganyu! You mustn't just chew them raw.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: ...Uh, I—I will.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Okay, I should be getting back. If Yaoyao stays out for too long, Mom and Dad will be worried sick...

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Everyone, I'm sure that the music festival will go off without a hitch, so don't worry! And in case I don't see you before, I wish you all a very happy Lantern Rite.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Thank you, Yaoyao. Happy Lantern Rite to you, too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We should go get dinner together sometime!

choices.text: But we will end the night on a high note.

talks.objective: Stay put and wait for 2 hours

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After a short wait, Keqing and Ganyu arrive at the square in front of Yujing Terrace...

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: #Greetings, {NICKNAME}, Paimon, and Mr. Dvorak. Call me Keqing.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Ganyu has brought me up to speed on everything. I'll get straight to the point.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: The Qixing have approved Ganyu's proposal. Over the next few days, I will be working with Mr. Dvorak on behalf of the Qixing to facilitate the organization of this concert.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yay, that's awesome!

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Please. The Qixing have a duty to deal with matters such as these. We have merely moved things forward to the next step.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: On a more personal note, I am an avid supporter of all things new and innovative.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: As such, it is my privilege to work with you on this exciting project.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Thank you so much, Keqing!

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: I had become quite discouraged after our recent failures, and was expecting the same outcome once again, so I didn't dare to get my hopes up...

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: ...Never in my wildest dreams could I have imagined this going so smoothly. It's like a dream come true...

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Right... Time for me to call in the performers. To stage a concert at a high-profile event like this is a rare opportunity. We'll make sure it's a night to remember!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yes! Our music man's finally getting fired up!

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Yes indeed. I know exactly what I'm doing from here.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: For a musician, music will always be the language they are most fluent in.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Oh, that... that can wait for another time.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Ganyu, what's wrong?

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: They told me all about Mr. Dvorak's situation, but I was so engrossed in drafting the proposal that I forgot all about it...

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Oh, that's quite alright. I don't even know what the person I'm trying to find looks like, so it was always going to be a long shot...

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Don't worry about me, Ganyu. Your time and energy are needed elsewhere. I'm sure you already have plenty to deal with between this concert and everything else going on during the Lantern Rite.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Thanks. It was just that I had a few initial thoughts when I heard your story. For instance... I wonder if this lady your ancestor met might have been an adeptus. What do you think?

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: To tell you the truth, Mr. Dvorak, I am somewhat related to the adepti myself. I am part-human and part-qilin. The qilin is an illuminated beast.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: I know how important your quest to get in touch with your roots must be to you, because I've been there myself before... trying to find out where I belonged...

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Did you say the adepti? And you're — illuminated beast? Part-qilin?

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Are you telling me... all the rumors of the Liyue adepti are real? So it's not just artistic license?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You bet they're real! Trying to track them down is tough, though... Like Jueyun Karst itself. There's nothing specifically stopping you from going there, but getting in and out of there is quite an ordeal.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Yes. Anyway... if you're looking to uncover a lost melody, or shine light on a forgotten aspect of Liyue's cultural history, I'm probably not the best person to ask.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: But if it's a person you're looking for, then I just might be able to help.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: ...I see, I think I understand the situation now. In that case, Ganyu, shall we divide the work between us?

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Yes, that was also my thought.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Great. So, Mr. Dvorak and I will concentrate on things here in the city to make sure the concert goes according to plan. In the meantime, Ganyu will reach out to her network and try to find the person he's looking for.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: How's your workload at the moment? Will you be able to make time?

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: I can probably get through everything in... two days. As long as I don't sleep.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Wait, what do you mean, "as long as I don't sleep"?

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Even for someone with illuminated beast blood in their veins, working for such an extended period without a break will take its toll on your health.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Somehow, that does not sound persuasive coming from Keqing...

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: "Be it but three moons from the start, he who returns is not he that departs."

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Hm! Even I know the importance of maintaining a healthy work-life balance!

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: ...In that case, three days.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Alright, I can work with that.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: If you have the time, would you join me for this search?

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: You're well-known to many of the adepti, and respected among the people. I'll feel much more at ease with your company.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Of course.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Okay, then let's meet back here in three days.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Watch this space, Mr. Dvorak! We'll get to the bottom of this.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: You're all so helpful and kind, I really... I just...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Just think... imagine if we found the adeptus lady or one of her descendants and got them to come to the performance. Wouldn't that be amazing?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It'd be such a happy reunion! And that's exactly what this festival's all about!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm sure the wind that guided you here feels the same way.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: ...You're right. Okay! I'm going to pull out all the stops to make this Lantern Rite a true extravaganza.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: We should probably get going. Mr. Dvorak, could you come with me to confirm the site?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh! We're coming too!

choices.text: We don't have enough information yet.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Lady Yuheng!

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Baiwen, what is it?

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Per Lady Ningguang's orders, I've been gathering intelligence outside of the city with the goal of uncovering and dispatching any trouble ahead of the festival.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: I am told that a strange melody was heard somewhere along the coast. I was wary of investigating further on my own, so I was just on my way to report this incident to Lady Ningguang...

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: But I'm worried that if we don't act right away, we may miss the window of opportunity to take appropriate action...

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: I understand. In that case, I—

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let us handle this one.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! Keqing, you're busy enough as it is. There's a ton of different things in this city that needs your attention.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Leave it to us! Don't worry — whatever it is, we'll definitely be able to handle it. Uh... Well, {M#he}{F#she} will handle it.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: #With {NICKNAME} on the case, it's as good as dealt with...

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Thank you, this will be a great help. I will inform Lady Ningguang about the situation. Once it's resolved, please come and find me again at Yujing Terrace and let me know.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Will do! And say hi to Ningguang for us!

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: You have my thanks too. Stay safe, and come back as soon as you're finished.

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Good luck.

talks.objective: Go to the place Baiwen mentioned

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Baiwen said the strange tune was coming from around here, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But Paimon doesn't hear anything... There doesn't seem to be a soul in—

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I was just wondering who in their right mind would come out to a place like this. So, it's you two.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yelan!? How did you sneak up on us like that? You nearly gave Paimon a heart attack!

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: You look pretty alive to me. Can't have spooked you that bad.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Y—You... ehh, fair enough...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Know anything about the strange music?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Ah, you're here for that, too? Saves me a bit of explaining.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Come with me. I've already reconned the perimeter, so we should be safe.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hm, the stuff by the door is in pretty good condition, though. It can't have been too long ago that someone was last living here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, how strange. It looks like it's been looted, except for the fact that there's no sign of a struggle.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The bad guys could have sneaked in while the owner was gone, but... then how do you explain why the door and windows are intact?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Seems you've done a pretty thorough inspection. So, any theories on what might have happened here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yelan, you didn't hide some of the evidence from us on purpose, did you?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Why would I make this more difficult for you? We're on the same side here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, well... Paimon gives up then. Paimon's got nothin'.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: What about you? Give up as well?

choices.text: It's difficult to theorize with so little evidence.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Yup. It's not obvious at first sight, that's for sure.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: To be honest, I was only able to put it all together because of some background knowledge about this area.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: A long time ago, there used to be a group of bandits in the Liyue countryside who would sound a horn every time they were about to raid a village.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: But it wasn't a rallying cry to rouse their fellow men. It was a disconcerting tune, meant to intimidate the weak and warn them of their impending doom.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: To escape with their lives, the villagers would abandon their homes and flee overnight, taking only their most valuable belongings with them. Everything else was left behind.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: The bandits were eventually brought to justice. But the fear and trauma remained in the villagers' hearts.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Whenever they heard that melody, they would feel like their lives were in danger once again, and flee immediately.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: The culprit of this crime exploited that very fear to get access to this house without having to force their way in.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whew, that's quite the story...

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: The victims obviously will have gotten quite a fright, but at least they won't be in any great danger.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: The important thing now is to find this copycat criminal.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: On any other day, that'd probably be a good idea. Unfortunately, it's not gonna work today.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Take a look around and you'll see what I mean. This criminal is clearly well-versed both in using music to commit crimes and in making a clean getaway.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Not only did they stay off the muddy road to avoid leaving footprints, it looks like they were also careful not to bring any gadgets with so much as a trace of elemental energy. Evidently, they were intent on keeping even the most experienced investigators off their trail.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Unfortunately for them, I'm one of the best trackers in the business. They're not about to get away with their little scheme on my watch.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So basically... if we wanna find the culprit, we just need to follow Yelan!

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Mm-hmm. As long as you can keep up.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Since the culprit's trying to be cautious and low-risk, I'll bet they left through an area with some vegetation for cover — but not so much that it would slow them down.

choices.text: It must have something to do with that melody...

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Your instincts are pretty good.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Hmm, or perhaps it's not instinct. The strange melody is one of the few pieces of information you have available, after all.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Let me share a folk story with you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There they are! Look, a Treasure Hoarder tent!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, not the Treasure Hoarders again! And so close to Lantern Rite, too... 'Tis not the season for their antics!

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: C'mon, let's round 'em up.

talks.objective: Go to the Treasure Hoarder camp

dialogues.speaker: Fujing
dialogues.text: Hey! Who are you? Where'd you come from?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Hmm... the evidence is conclusive.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Okay — confess, and we'll go easy on you. My patience is running low, so why don't you do us both a favor, hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Fujing
dialogues.text: You kidding me!? You think I'm scared of you?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Perhaps not. But you should be.

dialogues.speaker: Fujing
dialogues.text: Mercy, have mercy...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Ooh, it's a little late for that... I've come this far, I might as well finish the job.

dialogues.speaker: Fujing
dialogues.text: I surrender! I surrender, please! I'll do whatever you say! Please have mercy...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Hmph. Tell us everything.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: You have one chance, and I'm warning you: Don't make me ask twice...

dialogues.speaker: Fujing
dialogues.text: I won't! I swear!

dialogues.speaker: Fujing
dialogues.text: Um, y'know, so... Lantern Rite's nearly here, and like a lot of people, I wanted to buy a few nice things...

dialogues.speaker: Fujing
dialogues.text: I know I'm with the Treasure Hoarders and everything, but I don't really have any kind of experience with robbing people and whatnot, so I, uh... I don't have the guts to break into somebody's house.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, you're really going to complain to us about that?

dialogues.speaker: Fujing
dialogues.text: No, not at all. I'm just... telling it how it is.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Mkay. Continue.

dialogues.speaker: Fujing
dialogues.text: I racked my brains trying to think of what I could do, and eventually I remembered something from back when I was a kid. The bandits would blow their horn, and my grandma would grab us kids and run...

dialogues.speaker: Fujing
dialogues.text: I remember the tune, so I... I figured I'd try it for myself. ...I mean, just to see what would happen! At first, anyway... I seriously didn't expect that family to pack up and leave...

dialogues.speaker: Fujing
dialogues.text: But they did, and they just left all their stuff right there for the taking. It was too easy, I just... I couldn't resist...

dialogues.speaker: Fujing
dialogues.text: It was completely wrong of me, I know that now. I'll return everything that I took — it's all still in perfect condition. It'll be like it was never gone... Please, gimme a chance, huh? Let me make it right...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Give you a chance, huh? Sounds to me like you'd rather strike some kind of a deal... than spend Lantern Rite behind bars?

dialogues.speaker: Fujing
dialogues.text: Y—Yes, um... yes...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: You know how to bargain, I'll give you that. It's just a pity that you didn't confess at the first opportunity.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: You'll have to take a walk with me.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Once we've returned the goods, we'll find the owner of the house, and you can apologize to them in person. After that, I'll escort you to the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Fujing
dialogues.text: Yes, Ma'am!

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: You know, as a former victim of this kind of crime yourself, I doubt anyone understands the fear you inflicted quite as well as you do.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Does your greed matter more to you than your fear? More to the point, if you can play a tune from memory, don't you think you should be capable of making an honest living?

dialogues.speaker: Fujing
dialogues.text: You mean...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Heh, that's enough hints for you. You'll have plenty of time to reflect on all of this yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: There's not much left to wrap up, so I'll take it from here. Guess this is where I'll say goodbye.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What is it? Is there something else?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: I'm still not sure how you first got your hands on this information, so play it safe when you get back. Don't mention to anyone that you ran into me out here.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: You helped a lot with the investigation and arrest anyway, so it's perfectly fair for you to get all the credit. Just take it — it works better for me too.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: See you when I see you. And Happy Lantern Rite.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yelan's such a pro at this. With her taking it from here, it's as good as resolved.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Fwoosh! Random Event: "A Strange Melody" complete!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Although... it's kind of a shame that we never got that Treasure Hoarder guy to play the melody again.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: 'Cause Paimon's curious, that's why! It's like when you have a tune stuck in your head, but you don't even know what it is. It's driving Paimon crazy!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: When we were chatting with Mr. Dvorak, music seemed like such a positive thing.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And most music is, right? It can help us relax, feel all warm and fuzzy, recall happy memories, or even just think happy thoughts...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon never imagined that music could be used to commit crimes...

choices.text: It comes down to the ill will of the user...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, really? Huh... Makes sense... Paimon's musical understanding improves again!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well anyway, now that everything's resolved, let's get back to Liyue Harbor. Baiwen's still waiting for us with our Random Event rewards!

choices.text: Their bad deeds influenced the emotions associated with the music.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right? How could anyone not be!

talks.objective: Head to Yujing Terrace to report back to Baiwen

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Baiwen~! We're back. Everything's all sorted!

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: That's great news! Please wait here a moment, if you would be so kind. Lady Ningguang instructed me to advise her upon your return...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Baiwen hurries off...

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: My greetings to the both of you. Long time no see.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No need to be so formal with us, Ningguang! We've known each other for a long time now. You must be super busy with all the preparations for Lantern Rite. Don't mind us!

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: On the contrary, I think it is those that I have known longest to whom I should extend the greatest courtesies.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Alas, on a different day, I would invite both of you inside for some tea, and a brief respite from your travels...

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: But you're quite right: Trivial matters aside, there's no escaping the fact that we have a grand concert to organize.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Once the performance itself is over, we'll then need to invite the representatives of the Iridescence Tour for a discussion on future collaboration opportunities. The financing arrangements alone could well entail many rounds of discussion.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Simply put, there will always be work to do.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... you're already thinking that far ahead?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Hehe... well, we can discuss more current affairs if you'd prefer.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: I trust you saw this year's Mingxiao Lantern at the docks when you arrived at the city?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! It looked like... a goose? Which adeptus is it modeled on this time?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Sea Gazer. I believe you're familiar with the name?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Legend holds that he was free-spirited and easy-going. People described him as a cheerful soul and a loyal friend.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: "On this marvelous Lantern Rite, we pray that the fallen heroes may be guided home."

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: If the sound of music can flow like the rivers and streams into every corner of the land, perhaps the souls of those who have gone before us will hear the song of a new era. I wonder whether the melodies will be to their liking...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, they're gonna love them! Paimon's sure of it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: At least, if the guy you mentioned is anything to go by, the adepti and heroes of the past sound like a positive and free-spirited cheerful bunch. They're sure to be open to new music!

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Hehe, well let's hope so.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: I heard that you'll be going on a search with Ganyu to find the descendants of a fairy lady from a Fontaine legend.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: I'm sure this quest to uncover the truth behind an ancient story will turn into a most charming tale... Do share it with me, won't you? I couldn't bear to miss out.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Absolutely.

choices.text: It's been too long, I can't seem to recall...

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: You mustn't be afraid to try new things. If you never try, you'll never know.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: With your contribution, I'm sure this year's Lantern Rite will be a most spectacular one.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This place is completely empty... There's nothing valuable left here at all...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hm, the stuff by the door is in pretty good condition, though. It can't have been too long ago that someone was last living here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The doors and windows are all fine, so there definitely wasn't a break-in...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: As for Director Hu's list... Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: I shall attend to it after one last round of tea.

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: That lady I just talked to, Ganyu... she really thinks of everything.

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: It got me wondering... could it be that all our failed attempts so far have been down to our failure to properly prepare for different contingencies?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: ...She said she'll reach out to the Yun-Han Opera Troupe? I see.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Then I'll arrange for a rehearsal venue and accommodation as soon as possible. Everything should be ready tonight.

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Many thanks, Keqing.

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Heh... You know, I once heard someone from Liyue describe a person as "swift as lightning and agile as the wind." At the time, I thought it was a curious expression, and I had a hard time piecing together a mental image of such a person.

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: But now, having seen Keqing in action, I honestly can't think of any other way to describe it... It's such a vivid and expressive phrase. A testament to the richness of Liyue's culture.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: You're too kind, Mr. Dvorak.

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Program... list of performers... dress rehearsal schedule, and rehearsal venue...

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: What a spectacular stage we have... I have to make sure that the performances will be nothing short of exceptional.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Time flies so fast! Before you know it, Lantern Rite's almost here again.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The people of Liyue must've already started preparing for their most important festival of the year, right? Hopefully, Paimon will be able to check out tons of great food again this year!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, let's go to Liyue Harbor and see what's up!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Bamboo Shoot... Bamboo Shoot... "Nascent" Bamboo Shoot...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! This one's only just sprouted, and it looks super fresh. Paimon thinks this is the one!

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: The streets are breathtaking...

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Smiles and laughter everywhere I look... it's contagious.

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: I can almost feel the music in the air... I have the urge to start waving my conductor's baton...

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Hee-hee... I'm glad that you're enjoying the city!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, about this "senior" of yours Xinyan mentioned just now... is that anyone we know?

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Yes, it's Xiangling. She's mentioned you two before.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Xiangling's always thinking about cooking... Whenever she gets scrapes or burns, she just leaves them to heal by themselves. She definitely needs someone around her to look after her.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: I know you must have looked out for her a lot too in the time you've known her. So thank you for that.

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: I was wondering, what are your thoughts on music? What does it mean to you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh... Music... sounds... nice?

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Heh... truth be told, the question of what music means to people is one that I've been pondering for quite some time...

dialogues.speaker: Dvorak
dialogues.text: Let's revisit this question after the concert.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Here, look at this.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: These tracks are superficial, but they definitely didn't occur naturally. Something heavy was being dragged this way... meaning, we're headed in the right direction.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Huh, their pace has increased... Normally, people carrying a heavy load slow down as their journey goes on and they start to tire.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Whatever's motivating them to speed up must be psychological. For instance... reaching the home stretch.
